description: A custom Android view named DialView that displays a multi-position dial with accessibility support. This view handles drawing, user interactions, and accessibility events to inform accessibility services about its state.

classes.name: DialView
classes.description: A custom View that renders a dial with four selectable positions, handles click events to cycle the selection, and provides accessibility information about its state.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor called when inflating the view from XML, which initializes the custom view.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Paint objects, default selection, and sets up click listener for the view.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Calculates the dimensions and radius for drawing when the view's size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the dial, labels, and indicator circle on the canvas.

methods.name: computeXYForPosition
methods.description: Calculates the x/y coordinates for labels and indicator based on position index and radius.

methods.name: onPopulateAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Populates accessibility events with current state information, such as the selected mode and user instructions.
